rule:
The test-period read for a batch sweep -- by a rule written before looking, with no judgement in it.

From ``runs/<fid>/sweep_<tag>.json`` (train / valid only) it picks, mechanically:

* ``v_base`` (the original) and ``k_known`` (the known-family benchmark), always;
* the best variant of each of the 3 best KINDS (structure / leaf / memory / shape / neutral /
  hypothesis ...), ranked by pure-long Sharpe on the user's training period, among variants that
  pass the gates (cov >= 0.95, dist >= 0.5) and whose long leg is positive on BOTH train and valid;
* the two best candidates BUILT ON the known family (overlays, screens, or any hypothesis that contains
  it) -- reported apart, because they are the known family plus a tilt or minus a screen;
* ``k_known_xfrozen``, the generic screen (known family, never the frozen-quote names), as their benchmark.

Only these are scored on the holdout (the user's test period), in the user's convention: half-life fitted on
the user's training period, pure long book net of 15 bp.  The sign of the original and of the benchmarks is the
sign of their rank IC on the user's training period (the user's rule); a picked candidate keeps the sign it was
picked under (``sign_flip`` marks the rare weak signal whose rank IC changes sign once valid is added).  The read
is ledgered.

v_base.expr: ts_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)

k_known_xfrozen.why: 已知族 + 剔除近 15 日冻结盘口最重的 20%(通用筛子基准)

seg_lowliq_m.expr: cs_first_low40(neg(ts_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)), cross_mean(day_sum(Amt), 30))
seg_lowliq_m.why: 只在成交额最低 40% 的股票里按本因子选

h_d_pos_gap20.why: 03_decomposition 给出比值偏高的三个来源(1 分钟正自相关 / 跳跃 / 零收益多)。5 分钟为正的占比减 1 分钟为正的占比是第一个来源的直接读数,其余两个被抵消

sub_B_mul.expr: ts_mean(sub(div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), sub(mul(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_gt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), div(div(day_sum(select_where(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), abs_(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1))), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_sum(is_lt(sub(div(Close, in_delay(Close, 5)), create_like(Close, 1)), day_quantile(Ret, 0.05))), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06))), add(abs_(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05)), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.05), 1e-06)))), 20)

h3_blend_tailq75.expr: add(cs_rank(cross_mean(day_std(Amt), 30)), mul(cs_rank(cross_tail_mean_q75(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(in_pct(Close, 5), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), in_pct(Close, 5), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), 60)), create_like(cs_rank(cross_tail_mean_q75(div(day_sum(select_where(is_gt(in_pct(Close, 5), day_quantile(Ret, 0.95)), in_pct(Close, 5), create_like(Close, 0))), add(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), create_like(day_quantile(Ret, 0.95), 1e-06))), 60)), 0.25)))
h3_blend_tailq75.why: 用 TQ75 重做 h_f_blend_fix025(那条叠的是 spine:+16.0%/2.31 vs 家族 +15.4%/2.22,在噪声内)。结构与权重一字不改,只换被叠的那一半 —— 若叠加真能加分,应该在 ρk 更低、夏普更高的这一条上出现

h3_fam_x_tailq75.why: 筛子换成本轮最好的自有版本。scr_xhi_p 用的是原式(utrain +15.6%/2.37,打不过通用筛子 k_known_xfrozen 的 +18.5%/3.15);TQ75 的 ρk 只 0.28、Lshp 0.92 是 spine 的 1.6 倍,从没当过筛子。门槛:要赢 k_known_xfrozen 才算有用
